variants.headline: Still in view: the colony has voted
variants.sub: The colony has held its election to the Colonial Assembly.
variants.body:
An election to the Colonial Assembly has been held in {colony}. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

The colony has had its say at the ballot box. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Still in view: ballots before the business of government
variants.sub: Voting in an election to the Colonial Assembly has taken place.
variants.body:
The colony has held its election to the Colonial Assembly. This story remains under examination, {months_running} months into our coverage of the original event.

The colony has had its say at the ballot box. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Still in view: an Assembly election enters the record
variants.sub: An election to the Colonial Assembly has been held in {colony}.
variants.body:
Voting in an election to the Colonial Assembly has taken place. Our attention to this story continues after {months_running} months, with the original report still the starting point.

The colony has had its say at the ballot box. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
